info.name: SpotPulse API Tests
info.description: QA1: isolated API verification only. Fixed target localhost:18091; never Render or persistent H2. Reuses test-classpath QA2 authentication with real sessions and CSRF. Run complete folders or the whole collection. See spotpulse-backend/docs/QA1-postman-verification.md.

item.name: Public
item.description: Run this complete folder: independent fixture reset, session authentication and fresh CSRF precede its workflow.

exec: const actor = {"Setup \u2014 Create Space for Booking": "owner", "Setup \u2014 Create Room for Booking": "owner", "Clean booking room": "owner", "Clean booking space": "owner", "Other owner cannot cancel booking": "other", "Logged out session stays anonymous": "anonymous"}[pm.info.requestName] || "anonymous";
pm.test('Fixture/authentication setup succeeded', () => { throw new Error(message); });
pm.sendRequest({url: origin + path, method, header}, (error, response) => {
if (error || ![200,204].includes(response.code)) return stop('Local fixture/authentication endpoint failed');
if (typeof token.token !== 'string' || typeof token.headerName !== 'string') return stop('Invalid session CSRF response');
function authenticate() { csrf(token => send(actor === 'anonymous' ? '/api/auth/logout' : '/__e2e/login/' + actor, 'POST', token, () => {
if (pm.variables.replaceIn(pm.request.url.toString()).includes('{{')) return stop('Run this complete folder from its first request');
if (!Array.isArray(f.spaces) || f.spaces.length !== 8 || !Array.isArray(f.rooms)) return stop('Not the disposable harness');

pm.test("Offset page has current DTO fields", () => { const j=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.items).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(j.skip).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(j.limit).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(j.total).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('nextLink'); });

pm.test("Eight fixtures and next link", () => { const j=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.total).to.eql(8); pm.expect(j.items).to.have.lengthOf(3); pm.expect(j.nextLink).to.match(/^\/api\/spaces\?/); pm.collectionVariables.set('nextLink', j.nextLink); pm.collectionVariables.set('pageIds',JSON.stringify(j.items.map(s=>s.id))); });

pm.test("Offset page has current DTO fields", () => { const j=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.items).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(j.skip).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(j.limit).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(j.total).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('nextLink'); });

pm.test("Page changes without duplicates", () => { const j=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.skip).to.eql(3); pm.expect(j.items).to.have.lengthOf(3); j.items.forEach(s=>pm.expect(JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get('pageIds'))).not.to.include(s.id)); });
pm.test("Search selects the expected fixture", () => { pm.expect(pm.response.json().total).to.eql(1); pm.expect(pm.response.json().items[0].name).to.eql('QA2 Hub 08'); });

pm.test("Offset page has current DTO fields", () => { const j=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.items).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(j.skip).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(j.limit).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(j.total).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('nextLink'); });
